title: A resonator and a partially coherent beam
summary: A Fox-Li iteration finds the ABCD eigenmode of an apertured lens guide (radius 0.3877 mm against 0.3876 mm analytic, 0.003 % loss per round trip), and a Gaussian-Schell beam of M² = 2.5 is 1.9 times larger than a coherent one after a Rayleigh range (1.346 mm against 0.707 mm).
